product: External writes to managed Delta tables are now generally available
tagline: Support for creating and writing to Unity Catalog managed Delta tables from external Apache Spark clients is now generally available.
what_it_does: Support for creating and writing to Unity Catalog managed Delta tables from external Apache Spark clients is now generally available. Tables must have catalog commits enabled. This page describes how to use the Unity REST API to create, read, and write to Unity Catalog managed and external tables from external Delta clients.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: Support for creating and writing to Unity Catalog managed Delta tables from external Apache Spark clients is now generally available. Tables must have catalog commits enabled.
